evals.prompt: I just inherited this codebase and have no idea if the tests are any good. Can you audit the test suite and give me a full report?
evals.expected_output: Detects test runner, runs suite, produces structured audit report with health score, identifies quality issues

evals.prompt: Our tests take forever to run and some of them are flaky. Can you do a test maintenance audit?

evals.prompt: Before we do a major refactor I want to know how solid our test coverage is. Run a full test audit please.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive audit including test type balance, smell detection, maintainability assessment
